# sims v0.2.0 - Table of Contents

A library for creating test simulators for external services.

## Pages

- [Changelog](https://sims.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

## Modules

- [Sims](https://sims.hexdocs.pm/Sims.md): `Sims` is a collection of test simulator generators.

## Mix Tasks

- [mix sims.gen.config_module](https://sims.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Sims.Gen.ConfigModule.md): Generate a swappable configuation module
- [mix sims.gen.http_basic](https://sims.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Sims.Gen.HttpBasic.md): Generates a basic HTTP simulator
- [mix sims.gen.http_crud](https://sims.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.Sims.Gen.HttpCrud.md): Generates a HTTP simulator with CRUD functionality
